Name: Primary MFA method per user
Description: Shows which MFA method each user is prompted with first, how strong it is (phishing-resistant, standard, SMS/voice) and what to do next. Tenant readiness = users with a phishing-resistant primary method. Read-only.

Parameters.Name: Mode
Parameters.Label: Mode
Parameters.HelpText: Live reads each user's methods directly. Report uses the registration report (needs Entra ID P1/P2).

Parameters.Name: Show
Parameters.Label: Show
Parameters.HelpText: Which users to return: All, SmsOrVoicePrimary or NotPhishingResistant. Users that could not be checked are always returned.

Parameters.Name: IncludeGuests
Parameters.Label: Include guests
Parameters.HelpText: Include guest (B2B) accounts. By default only member accounts are checked.

Parameters.Name: IncludeDisabled
Parameters.Label: Include disabled
Parameters.HelpText: Include disabled accounts. By default only enabled accounts are checked.
